3.title: Price dropped $30
3.body: Clause 4.2 allows a price match within 14 days; 11 days left. Net after points reversal: about $29 (estimate).

citations.quote: If an item you purchased from Ridgeline Outfitters is offered by us at a lower price, a one-time price adjustment may be requested within 14 days after the purchase date.
When a purchase is refunded, in full or in part, including any price adjustment, points earned on the refunded amount are deducted from your balance in proportion to the amount refunded.

20.title: Price dropped again, but no claim is available
20.body: The jacket is now $95, $45 below what you paid. Clause 4.2 allows price adjustments only within 14 days of purchase, and that window closed on day 14. BackPocket won't prepare a form.

citations.quote: If an item you purchased from Ridgeline Outfitters is offered by us at a lower price, a one-time price adjustment may be requested within 14 days after the purchase date.

28.title: Return window closes in 2 days
28.body: Returning refunds $140 and reverses about 420 points (before pending price adjustment). The decision is yours.

citations.quote: Merchandise that is unworn, unwashed, and in new condition with original tags attached may be returned within 30 days of the purchase date for a refund to the original form of payment.
When a purchase is refunded, in full or in part, including any price adjustment, points earned on the refunded amount are deducted from your balance in proportion to the amount refunded.
